recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, moody portrait of a man in a dark suit, utilizing dramatic chiaroscuro lighting that casts a heavy shadow against a textured, cool-toned wall. The composition is centered with a focus on the subject's thoughtful expression and hand-to-chin pose, overlaid with clean, white serif and typewriter-style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark silhouette against a medium-gray textured background
Bright white typography anchored to the lower third of the frame
Dramatic split-lighting on the face creating a deep shadow profile on the wall
Textural contrast between the smooth skin/suit and the grainy, concrete-like backdrop
coreInvariants: Centered, waist-up framing of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, waist-up portrait occupying 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hand, highlighted by a single light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the illuminated face down to the large display text, then to the smaller subtitle at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark areas in the suit and shadows, balanced by the textured wall in the upper corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (suit and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool gray and muted blue (background wall)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value range from deep black to bright white highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to monochromatic or near-monochromatic cool hues

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses high-contrast serifs with thin hairlines
Secondary text uses slab-serif monospaced characters
All caps for the primary name, mixed case for the subtitle
characterSpecificRedesigns: Large 'J' and 'E' in the primary name act as bookends for the layout

composition.overlap: Overlays the bottom edge of the suit

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a mechanical typewriter font for the title to create a 'found' or 'urban' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif display style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody, high-contrast portrait of a man in a black suit, hand to chin, with dramatic side-lighting. The background should be a textured, cool-gray concrete wall. The right side of the image should feature a deep shadow of the subject's profile cast onto the wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered white text in the lower third. The top line should be a large, elegant serif font in all caps. The bottom line should be a smaller, monospaced typewriter font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting dramatic and high-contrast?
Is the typography pure white against the dark suit?
Is the background texture visible but not distracting?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for legibility of the white text on the dark background
Ensure the shadow profile on the wall is distinct
Verify the cool-toned color balance is consistent
Confirm the serif and typewriter font pairing works harmoniously
recipe.reuseFormula: Moody Portrait + Chiaroscuro Lighting + Textured Urban Backdrop + High-Contrast Serif/Typewriter Typography Overlay
